pull.title: bip-0352: fix input encodings in test vectors
pull.body:
Bitcoin Core's DER check fails on six distinct signature encodings
missing a sighash byte. These encodings occur in 20 distinct inputs
in the BIP352 fixtures. Vector 19 also has a Taproot control parity
mismatch in both sending and receiving copies.

Append SIGHASH_ALL outside DER and correct the control parity.
DER R/S values and all expected derivations remain unchanged.

The official reference runner passes all 29 vectors before and after.
Native DER and Taproot commitment checks accept the corrected
encodings. The fixtures omit full transactions, so this does not
establish complete transaction consensus validity.

Follow-up to bitcoin/bips#2339.

events.message:
bip-0352: fix input encodings in test vectors

BIP352 scanning assumes consensus-valid transactions. These fixtures
have a Taproot control parity mismatch and ECDSA encodings without
a sighash byte.

Correct both sending and receiving copies. The DER lengths and R/S
stay unchanged. Append SIGHASH_ALL outside DER as an encoding
correction. Complete transaction signature validity remains outside
these input-only fixtures.

The 29 vectors pass the official reference runner before and after.
Expected outputs, addresses and shared secrets are unchanged.

events.body:
ACK, this seems to address @fametrano's https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2339#issuecomment-6562005331.

These are partial (input-only, not full transactions); they do not constitute complete transaction-level consensus validation.

tACK https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2348/commits/04393c98c0e5268e02f465dbbfc6ea09bb599c99

Fixed the Taproot control parity mismatch for the NUMS point test vector and the missing sighash byte for legacy scripts.
Ran the new test vectors with [Bitcoin-core/bip352 module](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/src/test/bip352_tests.cpp), and all vectors passed.
